meta.descricao: The training school for activists of the Lúcia Revolutionary Front: study in steps, base group, a task in the world and someone who walks with you. For activists only.

porta.entrar: I'm already an activist: sign in
porta.texto: The training school for those who are active in the Front. Inside, it is for activists only: study in steps, base group, a task in the world and someone who walks with you.
porta.resto: The rest of the site stays open to everyone:
porta.comoEntrar: How to get into the School

passos.texto: For people aged 18 or over. Name, contact and the front you want to work in.
A single-use link, valid for 3 days. The e-mail does not mention the Front.
It accepts the sign-up and points you to your base group.

passos.titulo: Sign in with your site account
passos.texto: The School opens: you start at Step 1.

porta.degrausTitulo: What you learn, in three steps

degraus.texto: Class consciousness and the first steps as an activist.
Grassroots work, union organizing, people's communication, security and care.
Analysis of the current situation, training trainers, memory and the year of political education.

porta.semMilitancia: You are signed in, but your account is not in the activist group yet. If you have already signed up as an activist, it is with the coordination: as soon as they welcome you, the School opens here.
porta.semServico: The School needs the accounts service, which is not turned on in this copy of the site.
porta.falha: We could not check your membership right now.

casca.discretoTexto: neutral tab name, nothing in the history

casca.sairTexto: Ends your session on this device and erases the School’s private conversations and drafts stored here. To come back, you will need to sign in again.
casca.sairApagarTudo: Also erase my study saved on this device (path, record, readings)
